LanguageData.VAEI_JoinCult.beginLetter: {0} has succumbed to the void influence.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] has decided to leave and join the cult of the void. You can try to arrest [PAWN_objective] as [PAWN_pronoun] leaves. Otherwise, you may still see [PAWN_objective] next time the cultists decide to attack you.
LanguageData.VAEI_JoinCult.label: joining the cult
LanguageData.VAEI_JoinCult.recoveryMessage: {0} has had a change of heart and is coming back to the colony.
LanguageData.VAEI_Madness.beginLetter: {PAWN_nameDef} has lost the last connection to {PAWN_possessive} former self. {PAWN_possessive} regard for health, family, friendship, and love has been shattered by continuous exposure to the dark, corrupting psychic forces of the void.\n\n{PAWN_pronoun} will now enter a severe period of madness for several days as {PAWN_pronoun} struggles with {PAWN_possessive} altered mental state and the grim realization of the deepening nightmare. While there's a chance {PAWN_pronoun} might overcome this crisis and restore {PAWN_possessive} sanity, it's far more likely that {PAWN_pronoun} will be completely inhumanized.
LanguageData.VAEI_Madness.label: Madness
LanguageData.VAEI_Sacrificial.label: sacrificial
LanguageData.VAEI_ViciousMockery.beginLetter: {0} is on an mockery spree.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] will wander around, randomly mocking others.
LanguageData.VAEI_ViciousMockery.recoveryMessage: {0} is no longer on an mockery spree.
LanguageData.VAEI_VoidDrawing.label: void drawing
